generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The assertion has been updated to check for `"\"errors\" : false"` (with a space before the colon). Standard JSON responses from Elasticsearch typically do not include a space before the colon unless pretty-printing is enabled. Since `pretty` is set to `null` in the request, this change may cause the test to fail due to a string mismatch even if the operation was successful.
